title: The Long Fuse
centralArgument: Sarajevo did not make world war inevitable, and the war did not make dictatorship inevitable. Government actions during 1914–1933 mattered.
audience: High-school U.S. history, mixed reading levels

series.title: The Spark Was Not a Switch
series.question: Which choices turned a regional assassination into a European war?

series.title: The War and the Settlement
series.question: How did the war end, and who shaped the peace?

series.title: The Republic and the Appointment
series.question: Why did democratic crisis end in an appointment rather than an electoral majority?

footnote: Narrative built from The Long Fuse Batches 18–24; all archive rights must be reviewed before commercial publication.
narrativeQuestion: Which human choices between Sarajevo in 1914 and Berlin in 1933 made other paths possible?
